## 型

### Cause

```emela
opaque type Cause[E]
```

The cause of a failure. `E` is the error set it can fail with.

### CauseKind

```emela
enum CauseKind
```

The two kinds of causes.

- `Fail`

  An error raised with `fail`. Shows up in `E`.
- `Die`

  A defect (`[error.defect]`). Does not show up in the type.

## 値

### kind

```emela
fn kind[E](c: Cause[E]) -> CauseKind
```

The kind of the cause.

### to_string

```emela
fn to_string[E](c: Cause[E]) -> String
```

The cause as text: `error: ...` or `defect: ...`.

### raise

```emela
fn raise[A, E](c: Cause[E]) -> A fails E
```

Raises the cause again: `Fail` fails with the error, and `Die` is a defect.
